idea-plugin.name: Selection Bridge for Codex
idea-plugin.description:
Share your current editor selection with the OpenAI Codex CLI running in any terminal.

The plugin runs a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server on 127.0.0.1:63450. Register it once:

codex mcp add idea-selection --url http://127.0.0.1:63450/mcp

Then in any codex session just say "look at the code I selected in the IDE" — codex calls the get_idea_selection tool and receives the file path, line range and selected text. Works with all JetBrains IDEs.

Security note: the server listens on loopback only, but while the IDE is running any local process can query the current selection. Port and on/off switch: Settings | Tools | Selection Bridge for Codex.

中文说明：把当前编辑器选中的代码通过本地 MCP 服务共享给终端里的 Codex CLI。 安装后执行一次上面的注册命令，之后在 codex 里说「看我在 IDE 里选中的代码」即可。
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 — Initial release: built-in streamable HTTP MCP server, get_idea_selection tool, configurable port, on/off switch.
